data.desc: Marqeta (NASDAQ: MQ) enables payments innovation through its enterprise-grade modern card issuing platform. Spanning debit and credit offerings for both consumer and commercial, it provides card issuing and processing, credit services, accounts and money movement, risk and fraud, and user experience capabilities. The Company's solutions and expertise provide customers with greater control and agility in issuing payment credentials and allow them to build and embed financial services into their branded experience. With compliance and security built-in, Marqeta's end-to-end configurable platform is proven at scale, processing nearly $400 billion in annual payments volume in 2025 and certified to operate in more than 40 countries.
